note.en: Her signature and by far her best option. It gives 18% Impact and a 30% increase to all Shields she triggers, which boosts her Aegis Shield size and her Daze nicely, plus a squad-wide combat buff when an Interrupt or Perfect Dodge is triggered.

About 88% damage and 85% Daze. The only Daze-focused option among Defense W-Engines outside her signature. It gives a massive amount of HP% and Combat HP% unconditionally and a temporary Combat Impact boost after she is hit.

About 78% damage and 95% Daze. A W-Engine specialised for Energy, giving Energy Regen to an ally of your choice when played around, plus an ATK% boost. After taking damage she gains 16% Energy Regen for 12 seconds at max rank.

About 78% damage and 99% Daze. An Anomaly-themed option that increases her Anomaly buildup, handy for Anomaly teams that aim for Disorder. It costs some Daze and Shield strength, which makes it a trade-off.
